message.content:
s = input().strip()
size = len(s)
middle = (size - 1) // 2
odd = size % 2 != 0

i = 0
j = size - 1
counter = 1
palindrom = True

while True:
    begin = s[i]
    end = s[j]
    if begin != end:
        if counter == 0:
            palindrom = False
            break
        counter -= 1
    if i == middle:
        break
    i += 1
    j -= 1

if (palindrom and counter == 0) or (palindrom and counter == 1 and odd):
    print("YES")
else:
    print("NO")
